These Cults rely on their enhanced speed and fanatic loyalty to overwhelm their enemies, combining the alien strength with heavy weapons that provide support from afar. The Cults are usually founded by ambitious Soul-Snatchers who strike bargains with other species, before slowly establishing psychic control over them, amassing cults of adoring followers. Despite their power within the Cults, Soul-Snatchers must still rely on manipulation and act as hidden advisors, to ensure their true nature is not discovered by outsiders or initiates. Most Soul-Snatchers serve the Alien Hives as powerful advisors, valued for their psychic powers and intellect. [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/soul-snatcher-cults) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Fanatic: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9” of its position. ### Special Rules Bounding: When this unit is activated, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere fully within D3+1" of their position. Disintegrate: Ignores Regeneration, and against units where most models have Defense 2+ to Defense 3+, this weapon gets AP(+2). Increased Shooting Range Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +6" range when shooting once (next time the effect would apply). Mind Control: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which must take a morale test. If failed you may move it by up to 6" in a straight line in any direction. Precision Shooting Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +1 to hit rolls when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply). Re-Deployment: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next. Repel Ambushers: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit. Speed Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply). Spell Conduit: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken. Takedown Strike: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to attack in melee, it may make one attack at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown. ### Aura Special Rules Grounded Precision Aura: This model and its unit get Grounded Precision. Grounded Reinforcement Aura: This model and its unit get Grounded Reinforcement. Melee Slayer Aura: This model and its unit get Melee Slayer. Quick Shot Aura: This model and its unit get Quick Shot. Regeneration Aura: This model and its unit get Regeneration. Read more ### Spells Insidious Protection (1): Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Grounded Reinforcement once (next time the effect would apply). Mind Corruption (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(1) and Surge. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger. Deep Hypnosis (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 18", which must take a morale test. If failed you may move it by up to 6" in a straight line in any direction. Psychic Onslaught (2): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 4 hits with Disintegrate. Bio-Displacer (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Teleport once (next time the effect would apply). Brain Burst (3): Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 3 hits with AP(2) and Deadly(3). ### Units ### Heroes Supreme Leader [1] Qua 3+Def 4+ 85pts Sharp Claws(A4, Disintegrate) Fanatic, Fast,
